public_rationale: The fair test is whether ChatGPT repeatedly miscounted vowels in province names during the reported session. Correct answers elsewhere or an eventual correction would not refute those errors. The post links a conversation, but read_page returned only its title. Marcus's account cannot independently prove his own claim, and no accessible session record was found. The missing record prevents either support or contradiction.
limitations: This is an evidence-access limitation, not a finding that the reported errors did not happen.
The assessment concerns the February 4, 2025 session, not ChatGPT's general or subsequent capabilities.

criteria.support_condition: An authentic record of the session shows repeated incorrect vowel counts for Canadian province names, across entries or successive answers, when compared with the letters in those names.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A complete authentic record shows that the reported repeated province-name counting errors did not occur. A majority of correct counts or a later successful correction is insufficient to contradict the claim.
